agent.problem: Too many of this stop's choices depend on discovering unseen wording rather than reasoning from earlier cards. Card 2 gives no clue to the scope of the group called to sing, card 4 gives no clue to the frequency, card 9 does not establish why the gods must be idols rather than angels or kings, and card 11 provides no context for evaluating the sanctuary statement. That makes four of the six choice cards uninformed discoveries, so most choices in the stop are not informed guesses.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
